notes.title: v8.8.4 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Greetings from Com2uS!



v8.8.4 has been updated on Steam today, and an auto update will be held to install the new version.

The process won't take long, but you may experience a sudden crash if you are logged in when the update begins.

Please make sure to come back to the Village and end your game safely to save your game data before the update starts.



========================

\[Update Schedule per Server]

Global - 3:45 AM PDT

Europe - 12:45 PM CEST

Asia - 6:30 PM TST

Korea - 7:00 PM KST

Japan - 7:30 PM JST

China - 6:30 PM CST​

===================================================​

​※ You won't be able to enter \[World Arena and World Guild Battle​]​ during \[03:00 AM - 03:45 AM PDT], and other content can be played normally.



=====================================

v8.8.4 Update Details 

=====================================​​​​​​



▶ Trial of Ascension (Hell) Revamp

- The battle balance has been adjusted as follows.

: The Attack Speed and Critical Rate of enemy Monsters in Trial of Ascension (Hell) have been lowered.

: Goals will now be categorized and applied to either allies or enemies.



- You can now select up to six Goals on the battle preparation screen.



[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/1_1757660337.%EC%8B%9C%ED%83%91%EB%8F%84%EC%A0%84%EB%AA%A9%ED%91%9C_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1757660337.png"]



: Goals refresh when ToA resets on the 14th of each month, and the same conditions apply to all floors (1F - 10F) until the next reset.

: Goals available during Sep. 14, 10:00 PM - Oct. 14, 10:00 PM PDT are as follows. 

: Various other Goals will be introduced each month with the monthly ToA reset.



[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2%20EN_1757663047.png"]



- The current star system will be removed, and a new currency, "Tower Tokens," will be added along with the \[Tower Shop].



[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2_1757660348.%EC%8B%9C%ED%83%91%EC%83%81%EC%A0%90_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1757660348.png"]



: Tower Tokens are a dedicated currency used in the \[Tower Shop]. You will receive 100 as a basic reward when you clear each floor for the first time, and up to an additional 400 depending on the number of Goals achieved.

: The more Goals you select, the more Tower Tokens you can obtain. Tower Token rewards lower in quantity than what you have already received will not be granted again. (For example, if you have obtained 200 Tower Tokens and later clear the floor again with Goals set for 150, no Tower Tokens are given; if you clear with Goals set for 400, the difference of 200 will be given.)

: Tower Tokens obtained are retained regardless of the ToA reset and can be exchanged for various items in the \[Tower Shop]. The list of exchangeable items is shown below.

[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2%20EN_1757658368.png"]



- Improvements related to Trial of Ascension (Hell) battles are as follows. 

: Hell difficulty can now be played without Energy consumption.

※ Mana Stones will no longer be dropped in Hell difficulty.

: The temporary engraving feature that lets you use Monsters in the Normal Monster Sealed Shrine has been added.

: The final floor (10F) will now feature only a boss battle without waves.



- The ranking tally method has been revamped.

: Hell difficulty rankings will now be determined by the number of Tower Tokens accumulated between monthly resets. Tower Tokens are earned like other currencies, but only the amount obtained during the relevant period will count toward the rankings.

: You can obtain up to 5,000 Tower Tokens in total by clearing all floors and achieving all Goals.

※ The revamp will be applied starting from ToA (Hell) beginning on Sep. 14, 10:00 PM PDT.



▶ Challenge of Ascension Revamp

- The top floors have been expanded as follows.

: \[Spires of Ascension] has been expanded from 100F → 140F. 

: \[Attribute Towers (Fire/Water/Wind/Light/Dark)] have been expanded from 30F → 40F. 

* The floors cleared in each Attribute Tower are combined to unlock new floors in Spires of Ascension.



- The battle balance has been adjusted as follows.

- The HP, Defense, Attack Power, and Attack Speed of enemy Monsters in Challenge of Ascension have been lowered.

: Goals will now be categorized and applied to either allies or enemies.

- The floors where certain Goals are applied have been changed. Sections where difficulty spiked due to Goals have moved to higher floors, lowering the difficulty of the middle floors.



[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2%20EN_1757657950.png"]



- The ranking tally method has been revamped.

: Previously, rankings were based on who reached higher floors faster. After the revamp, Summoners who clear with fewer turns will be ranked higher.

: CoA rankings prior to the v8.8.4 update can be found under \[Challenge of Ascension > Ranking > Hall of Fame].



[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/3_1757660361.%EB%9E%AD%ED%82%B9_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1757660361.png"]



※ The revamped rankings are not updated in real time and may take some time to be reflected.




- Other improvements related to \[Challenge of Ascension] are as follows. 

: An icon has been added to the entry screen to show the floors reached by Friends and guild members.

: The temporary engraving feature that lets you use Monsters in the Normal Monster Sealed Shrine has been added.

: A dedicated discussion board has been added to the \[Strategy Info] menu on the battle preparation screen for each floor, where you can post strategies or view those shared by others.



▶ \[Rune] Bulk Power-Up Feature Added

- A \[Power Up Selected] feature has been added to let you power up Runes in bulk after a Repeat Battle or under \[Manage].

- You can select up to 30 Runes for \[Power Up Selected], set the desired power-up level, and \[Confirm] to power up in bulk.



[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/4_1757660373.%EC%84%A0%ED%83%9D%EA%B0%95%ED%99%94_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1757660373.png"]



- In the \[Manage] menu, a \[Select All] feature is provided to automatically select up to 30 Runes below Power-up Lv. 12.



[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/5_1757660384.%EC%9D%BC%EA%B4%84%EC%84%A0%ED%83%9D_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1757660384.png"]



※ Engraved Runes will not be selected for \[Power Up Selected] and \[Select All].



▶ \[Runes/Artifacts] Value Comparison Feature Added

- In the Rune/Artifact info screen, you can now press and hold the score area to view the number of Runes or Artifacts you own with the same conditions (type, number, and main property), the overall ranking based on score, and rankings by sub property.



[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/6_1757660395.%EC%88%9C%EC%9C%84%EC%A0%95%EB%B3%B4_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1757660395.png"]



- The UI of the \[Sell Option] screen for Runes, Artifacts, and Gems/Grindstones has been improved to make the \[Recommendations] button more noticeable.



[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/7_1757660406.%EC%B6%94%EC%B2%9C%EA%B2%8C%EC%8B%9C%ED%8C%90_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1757660406.png"]



▶ \[Minigame] 10 New Masks Added



▶ Product Icons Merged

- Up to two product icons will now appear on the left side of the Sky Island screen, and other products for sale have been grouped into a pop-up for better visibility.



[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/8_1757660416.%EC%83%81%ED%92%88_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1757660416.png"]



▶ Other Improvements and Changes

- Friend requests from blocked Summoners will no longer be received.

- When copying a strategy deck from \[Strategy Info > Strategy Deck] on the battle preparation screen, if you own multiple of the same Monster, a more suitable Monster will be selected.

: Affected Content: Cairos Dungeon / Rift Dungeon / Dimension Hole / Tartarus’ Labyrinth / Monster Subjugation / Trial of Ascension

- \[Collab Missions > Reward Info] A feature has been added to purchase mission rewards for unachieved levels with 100 Crystals, and the UI has been improved to display the reward list more clearly.



[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/9_1757660430.%ED%8C%A8%EC%8A%A4_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1757660430.png"]



▶ World Arena Improvements and Fixes

- The World Arena Tutorial icon will no longer be displayed while additional resources are downloading or when World Arena is under maintenance.

- \[Normal Battle] The battle result screen will now play more smoothly.

- \[Google Play Games on PC] Fixed an issue where the Monster selection screen would reset during the pick & ban phase under certain conditions.



▶ Harmful Effect Description Modified

- \[Help > Battle > Harmful Effect] The description of "Harmful Effect Removal Blocked" has been modified.



[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2%20EN_1757657973.png"]



▶ \[Shop > Efficient > Special Pack] Devilmon Special Pack Ⅰ/Ⅱ, Reappraisal Stone Special Pack Added



[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2%20EN_1757657990.png"]



▶ Game Errors Fixed

- \[Monster Subjugation] Fixed an issue where an error pop-up occurred when attempting to enter battle with vacant deck slots.

- (Android) Fixed an issue where the navigation bar was not displayed properly and was partially covering the game screen on certain devices.​



​▶ Skill descriptions of some Monsters have been modified.




[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/EN_1757659866.png"]

notes.title: Developer's Preview #5: September Update
notes.notes:
[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/250827_smon_800_land_en_1756961158.jpg"]
[p align="start"]Greetings from the Summoners War Dev Team!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Though summer is reaching its end, the midday sun is still strong in Korea.
[p align="start"]However, the breeze is getting cooler in the mornings and evenings, reminding us that the seasons are slowly changing.
[p align="start"]Even during this seasonal shift, the heat continues in Summoners War—thanks to SWC2025.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Thanks to your unwavering support again this year, the SWC2025 Regional Qualifiers have been more intense than ever.
[p align="start"]The upcoming matches are also adding heat, and we hope you claim all the rewards prepared in the prediction event.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Also, we thank all players who have given their all in their matches and those preparing for upcoming ones.
[p align="start"]We ask everyone to stay tuned until the end of the SWC2025 journey, from the Regional Cups to the World Finals.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]In this Developer’s Preview, we have prepared details about the update planned for September.
[p align="start"]The update includes the Trial of Ascension (Hell) revamp, addition of new floors to Challenge of Ascension,
[p align="start"]and the new World Arena content, “Challenge Battle."
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Let's dive into the fifth \[Developer's Preview]!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Currently, having to achieve challenge objectives on top of the high base difficulty for rewards is fatiguing many Summoners.
[p align="start"]Starting with the Trial of Ascension that resets on Sep. 14 PDT, we plan to lower the base difficulty of the Hell mode
[p align="start"]and ease the reward acquisition structure and conditions to reduce the overall gameplay burden.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]1. The base difficulty without challenge objectives will become easier.
[p align="start"]While preserving the identity of Trial of Ascension (Hell) as challenging content,
[p align="start"]the revamp will lower the base difficulty and provide a variety of challenge objectives for a more engaging field of challenge.
[p align="start"]We are also preparing new enemy teams to match the adjusted difficulty, along with a downward adjustment of enemy stats.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]2. The reward structure will be improved.
[p align="start"]The final reward (Legendary All-Attribute Scroll) in Hell mode currently requires 20 stars, which means clearing all 10 floors on base difficulty alone is not enough to claim the reward.
[p align="start"]We plan to improve the reward acquisition structure, lowering the hurdle for rewards and adjusting the reward tiers, so that the final reward can be claimed by clearing all floors on base difficulty alone.
[p align="start"]Additionally, to make clear points more useful, the ToA (Hell) rewards will be changed to a system similar to the Arena's Glory Shop, where items can be purchased with clear points earned from clearing floors and achieving challenge objectives.
[p align="start"]Furthermore, these clear points will not reset when ToA resets; they will carry over to the following month.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]3. The range of selectable challenge objectives will be expanded.
[p align="start"]ToA (Hell) will offer more freedom in selecting the challenge objectives, instead of presenting two fixed goals per floor.
[p align="start"]More options mean more diverse strategies and more opportunities to try out unique tactics.
[p align="start"]You will be able to set challenge objectives that are easier for you to tackle, or, if you prefer a more challenging experience, you can set many objectives at once and play accordingly.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]4. The targets affected by challenge objective effects will be distinguished between enemies and allies.
[p align="start"]The effects of challenge objectives that are currently applied equally to both allies and enemies will be clearly divided and applied as either enemy-only effects or ally-only effects.
[p align="start"]For example, the “Limits harmful effects to 1 turn" goal on 1F will be changed to an enemy-only condition after the update.
[p align="start"]At first glance, this change may raise concerns about increased difficulty, but our goal is to shape an environment where we can design stage balance more precisely, which will ultimately lower the difficulty of ToA (Hell) when paired with appropriate adjustments to enemy Monster stats.
[p align="start"]This modification will also be applied to Challenge of Ascension with the same intent.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]To allow more Summoners to enjoy Challenge of Ascension in a properly balanced environment,
[p align="start"]we plan to lower the overall difficulty of CoA while also revamping the challenge objectives and ranking system.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]1. Difficulty adjustments and expansion of the top floors.
[p align="start"]Each Attribute Tower will be expanded from 30 floors to 40 floors, and Spires of Ascension from 100 floors to 140 floors.
[p align="start"]Along with the expansion, we are preparing balance adjustments to make CoA less demanding by adjusting enemy stats and changing the floors where certain challenge objectives appear.
[p align="start"]Our goal is to make lower floors clearable without burden, while higher floors require more strategic play to provide an adequate sense of satisfaction. Extensive stage balance tests are underway to that end.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]2. Ranking criteria will be changed.
[p align="start"]The ranking criteria currently based on the date and time of clearing a floor will be changed to the number of turns taken, so that the rankings reflect how efficient and well-executed a strategy was.
[p align="start"]While preserving the honor of Summoners who cleared the top floors first in the \[First Conqueror] info, the achievements of Summoners who demonstrated advanced strategies will be recorded in the rankings.
[p align="start"]Due to the criteria change, rankings will be newly tallied after the update; pre-update CoA ranking records will be preserved separately in a \[Hall of Fame] so that the records of current CoA rankers remain.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]3. A debate board for Challenge of Ascension will be added.
[p align="start"]A debate board will be added to CoA for sharing strategies on climbing the towers.
[p align="start"]Only Summoners who have cleared a given stage will be able to create posts on that stage’s board.
[p align="start"]Share your own CoA strategies and tips with fellow Summoners!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]4. The Challenge of Ascension revamp will be introduced during the first update in September.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]\[Challenge Battle] is a new mode where battles are conducted using a fixed pool of Monsters provided, instead of your own.
[p align="start"]We hope this lets Summoners who lack certain Monsters or have not farmed Runes to enjoy RTA in the same environment.
[p align="start"]By providing a fixed Monster pool for battle, we aim to deliver a new World Arena mode in which strategic elements—such as understanding Monsters and building teams—take center stage.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]1. A preset number of Monsters will be provided.
[p align="start"]From a pool of around 30 to 40 Monsters, 12 to 16 Monsters will be assigned to either side at the start of battle.
[p align="start"]All Monsters will be 6★, Lv. 40, with MAX skill levels, and will have preset Runes and Artifacts engraved.
[p align="start"](The total Monster pool and the number of Monsters provided at battle start are still under final discussion and testing.
[p align="start"]We will share more details in a future update notice.)
[p align="start"]After proceeding with the pick & ban phase using the provided Monsters, the battle will begin.
[p align="start"]The base pool of 30 to 40 Monsters will remain unchanged throughout a season and be applied globally to all Summoners,
[p align="start"]while the 12 to 16 Monsters assigned for battle are determined randomly at the start of each battle.
[p align="start"]Monsters assigned to you will not appear for your opponent, meaning you will be able to infer your opponent's Monster pool.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]2. The \[Challenge Battle] season will proceed separately from the existing World Arena.
[p align="start"]We are carefully reviewing the season duration in order to provide a new Monster pool each season for diverse strategies.
[p align="start"]If the season is too long, \[Challenge Battle] may become repetitive within the same pool;
[p align="start"]if it is too short, the pool may change before deck guides or strategies can be established, stirring confusion.
[p align="start"]We are planning to set an appropriate length by observing the gameplay flow following the introduction of \[Challenge Battle].
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]3. \[Challenge Battle] continues until you record a total of three losses.
[p align="start"]In \[Challenge Battle], your goal is to record as many wins as possible before losing three times.
[p align="start"]There is no limit to the number of entries; you can play as freely as you wish.
[p align="start"]However, once you reach three losses, your number of wins at that time will be recorded as your performance record.
[p align="start"]If you choose to enter again, your record will reset to 0 wins and 0 losses and start anew.
[p align="start"]Who will record the most wins on each server? May the most creative strategies log as many wins as possible!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]4. \[Challenge Battle] Reward Structure
[p align="start"]We are considering one-time rewards based on seasonal achievements.
[p align="start"]Most rewards will be relatively easy to get, as our goal is to engage more Summoners to enjoy the content without pressure.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]5. \[Challenge Battle] is targeted for a late-September update.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]That’s all for today’s Developer’s Preview!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We will continue to share new content and improvements and listen carefully to your valuable feedback.
[p align="start"]If you have any questions or opinions about this update, please feel free to share them anytime.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]The next Developer’s Preview will likely share news about the large-scale update scheduled for mid-November.
[p align="start"]Internally, we dubbed it \[Summoners War: Tomorrow] and are eagerly exploring ways to bring powerful changes to the game.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/1080x1350_en_1756974171.jpg"]
[p align="start"]We are truly grateful for all the love and support you send to Summoners War.
[p align="start"]Please look forward to more exciting updates!​​

notes.title: v8.8.3 Update Notice
notes.notes:
v8.8.3 Update Notice

Greetings from Com2uS!



v8.8.3 has been updated on Steam today, and an auto update will be held to install the new version.

The process won't take long, but you may experience a sudden crash if you are logged in when the update begins.

Please make sure to come back to the Village and end your game safely to save your game data before the update starts.



========================

\[Update Schedule per Server]

Global - 12:45 AM PDT

Europe - 9:45 AM CEST

Asia - 3:30 PM TST

Korea - 4:00 PM KST

Japan - 4:30 PM JST

China - 3:30 PM CST

========================

※ You won't be able to enter \[World Arena and World Guild Battle​]​ during \[12:00 AM - 12:45 AM PDT], and other content can be played normally.



=====================================

v8.8.3 Update Details 

=====================================
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]▶ New Minigame \[Jump Jump] Lv. 1 Added
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/1_1756254000.%EB%AF%B8%EB%8B%88%EA%B2%8C%EC%9E%84_%EA%B3%B5%ED%86%B5_1756254000.jpg"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]- Jump Jump is a minigame where you step on jump items to climb as high as possible within the time limit.
[p align="start"]- Controls: Use the directional keypad to move left or right, and the jump button to step on items and climb higher.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]▶ \[Minigame] 10 New Masks Added
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]▶ New Notification Icon
[p align="start"]- A notification icon will now appear when Collab Missions are completed.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2_1756254023.%EC%BD%9C%EB%9D%BC%EB%B3%B4%EC%9E%84%EB%AC%B4_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1756254023.png"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]▶ Collab Special! Nina Williams Transmogrification
[p align="start"]- Don't miss out on the opportunity to claim a special Transmog available only during the event period.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/3_1756254041.%ED%98%95%EC%83%81%EB%B3%80%ED%99%98_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1756254041.png"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]▶ \[Arena] Tekken Collab Special Theme Applied
[p align="start"]- Period: After v8.8.3 update on Aug. 27 - Oct. 1, 7:59 AM PDT
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/4_1756254195.%EC%95%84%EB%A0%88%EB%82%98_%EA%B3%B5%ED%86%B5_1756254195.png"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]- You can toggle the seasonal theme ON/OFF in the game settings. (Settings > Options > Other Settings)
[p align="start"]- The summer season theme previously applied to \[Arena/ World Arena/ Guild Rival Battle/ Siege Battle] has ended.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]▶ \[Arcade Battle] Boss Difficulty Improved
[p align="start"]- (Hard) Azazel's \[Ancient Disaster] will now steal beneficial effects with a 50% → 30% chance.
[p align="start"]- (Hell) True Devil Kazuya's \[Demon's Retribution] will now replace beneficial effects with Continuous Damage with a 30% → 20% chance and will no longer grant Block Harmful Effect Removal.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2%20EN_1756254231.png"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]▶ \[Content Loading Screen] Ranking Display Added
[p align="start"]

[p align="start"][img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/5_1756259986.%EB%A1%9C%EB%94%A9%EC%9D%B4%EB%AF%B8%EC%A7%80_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_2_1756259986.png"]

[p align="start"]- The top 4 rankings will now be displayed on the content loading screen when entering the content.
[p align="start"]- The list of applied content is as follows. 
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2%20EN_1756254337.png"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]※ The ranking information may slightly differ from the actual info depending on the update timing.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]▶ \[World Arena] Modifications
[p align="start"]- The minimum level requirement for World Arena has been raised from Lv. 35 → Lv. 50.
[p align="start"]: If you have prior World Arena match history, you can continue to play even under Lv. 50.

- A World Arena tutorial battle has been added, and some tutorials have been improved. 
[p align="start"]: The tutorial battle becomes available upon reaching Lv. 50 if you have no World Arena play history.
[p align="start"]

▶ \[Shop > Efficient] Collab Special! Surprise Shop
[p align="start"]- Surprise Shop Period: After v8.8.3 update on Aug. 27 - Sep. 14, 11:59 PM (server time)
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/6_1756254362.%EA%B9%9C%EC%A7%9D%EC%83%81%EC%A0%90_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1756254362.png"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]- The Surprise Shop offers the following items.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2%20EN_1756254388.png"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]※ The daily free Mystical Scroll gift refreshes every day at 12:00 AM (server time).
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/7_1756254415.%EA%B9%9C%EC%A7%9D%EC%83%81%EC%A0%90_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1756254415.png"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]- \[Weekly Special Products] will be available for three weeks, offering different items each week.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2%20EN_1756263097.png"]

[p align="start"]※ For the 6★ Legend Rune product, you can see three Rune options when claiming from your Inbox and choose one to keep.
[p align="start"]※ The Weekly Special Products change on Mondays at 12:00 AM. (Week 1: After v8.8.3 update on Aug. 27 - Aug. 31, 11:59 PM)
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]▶ \[Shop > Efficient > Special Pack] Time-Limited Product! Collab Special Pack
[p align="start"]- Sale Period: After v8.8.3 update on Aug. 27 - Sep. 14, 11:59 PM (server time)
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2%20EN_1756269337.png"]

[p align="start"]▶ Monster Skill Description Modified
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/2%20EN_1756254480.png"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]▶ Other Improvements and Changes
[p align="start"]- \[Guild Tower > Replay] and shared replays in Guild Chat will now display win/loss results.
[p align="start"]- You can now delete your own posts in Strategy Info > Dungeon Debate for Cairos Dungeon, Rift Dungeon, and Dimension Hole Raid.

Most Successful Defenses > Least Failed Defenses > Arena Grade > Most Recently Created

[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/6_1749549383.%EB%A7%88%EB%B2%95%EC%A0%9C%EC%9E%91_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1749549383.png"]

[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/8_1749549641.%EB%A7%8C%EB%8A%A5%EC%86%8C%ED%99%98%EC%84%9C_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1749549641.png"]

[img src="https://hive-fn.qpyou.cn/hubweb/contents/9_1749549785.%EA%B8%B8%EB%93%9C%EC%A0%84%ED%88%AC%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8_1749549785.png"]

notes.title: Developer's Preview #3: 11th Anniversary Update II
notes.notes:
Greetings from the Summoners War Dev Team!

We're back with another Developer's Preview to discuss the second part of the 11th Anniversary Update.
For our team, reading all the diverse opinions from Summoners after posting dev-related notices is one of our great joys.
The Siege Battle revamp from the previous Developer’s Preview has been applied starting Season 18 on Mar. 31.
We hope you enjoy the newly updated Siege Battle and look forward to hearing your valuable feedback.

Our team is always striving to make Summoners War a more enjoyable and convenient game based on your feedback.
Your voices always motivate us, so please continue to share your thoughts.

Let's dive into the topics we have prepared today.


* Rift Raid bosses of Fire, Water, and Wind Attributes dropping specific types of Grindstones will be added to make Grindstone farming more efficient.
* We are reviewing the bosses’ skill sets to create a meaningful challenge without making team building for boss raids overly burdensome.
* The existing Chaos Beast Khi'zar Kha'jul will remain as a neutral attribute raid boss that drops all Grindstones.
* Below is an overview of the skills and rewards for each boss. 

Other than the changes in the [Rageful Roar] skill seen below, the rest of the skills will remain the same as the Chaos Beast.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/348893c211dd98eed6d58337aaa580b095dae501.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/95878e8ca2a571989affea6a46628139d5bb8179.png


* We plan to improve the usability of Grindstones and Gems by retaining amplified values of a grinded sub property even when a Gem is used on the sub property.

Let’s say a Rune has a SPD +7 sub property obtained through Gem conversion.
After amplifying it with a SPD +5 Grindstone, the sub property becomes SPD +12.

If you then use a SPD Legend Gem to convert it to SPD +10:

As-is: The grinded value is removed, resulting in SPD +10.
To-be: The grinded value remains, resulting in SPD +15 (Gem +10, Grindstone +5).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/caccfd3ee2fed437a42b0bbef25da82fbd3909cb.png

* Currently, using a Gem of the same sub property resets the amplified value, forcing you to rely on Gems to get a satisfactory result before using a Grindstone.
With this change, you can apply Grindstones first without worrying about losing the amplified value.
* However, using a Gem of a different sub property will still remove the amplified sub property and grant a new sub property.
* The addition of Attribute Raid Bosses and the usability improvements for Grindstones and Gems are scheduled for release in the late April update.


* The game will be updated to v8.6.9 on Apr. 12 to introduce [Arena & Arena Interserver Battle revamp], [Monster & Arena background art renewal], and [11th anniversary events] discussed in the previous Developer's Preview.
* We would also like to share the details on the new Arena rank requirements below as many Summoners were keen to see how the Arena league restructuring will pan out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/26799e7584bc7db97d1c539e33b3f4aad843c44f.png


* We are actively working to resolve some key issues related to the Siege Battle Rune separation.
* We expect to introduce this update by the end of May.

That concludes today's Developer's Preview!

We will continue striving to make Summoners War more enjoyable and convenient.

If you have any questions or feedback regarding the update plans, please don't hesitate to share them.

We sincerely hope the improvements and system refinements prepared for the 11th anniversary will further enhance your gameplay experience.

We appreciate your continued love and support, and please look forward to more exciting updates!​​

notes.title: Developer's Preview #2: 11th Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Greetings from the Summoners War Dev Team!

We’re back with the second [Developer’s Preview].

First, we sincerely appreciate your overwhelming interest and feedback on the first Developer’s Preview.

Updates such as the Hall of Magic improvements, World Arena Monster Info menu, and Rune/Artifact management enhancements were implemented in February, and we are thrilled to see your positive response.

We also look forward to your excitement about the upcoming Siege Battle revamp, which is scheduled for a late March update.

Today, we’re here to share details about the 11th Anniversary Update.

As we prepared to celebrate 11 years of Summoners War, we took a step back to reflect on the game and discuss improvements to make it more engaging.

Through careful deliberation, we’ve planned a series of updates spanning April and May introducing major revamps to Arena, Arena Interserver Battle, and Rift Raid/Dungeon, along with various QoL improvements and system updates.

To thoroughly cover these changes, we’ll be releasing two Developer’s Previews dedicated to the 11th Anniversary Update.

This preview will focus on the Arena and Arena Interserver Battle revamps, along with Monster and background art renewals scheduled for April.

Without further ado, let’s dive into the second [Developer’s Preview]!



* We are reviewing the introduction of a new Arena League only for new Summoners to help new Summoners enjoy the content better.

* We are also working on restructuring the Arena League system to address rank disparity and balance issues caused by different server populations.

1. Rookie League for New Summoners

- Many new Summoners struggle to enjoy Arena due to the gap in experience with veteran Summoners. To address this, we will introduce a rookie league exclusively for new Summoners.
- Summoners will automatically be placed in the Rookie League upon entering Arena for the first time and will remain there for at least four weeks. Afterward, they can choose to stay in the Rookie League or move to the regular Arena League at their own pace.
- To encourage progression, rewards in the Rookie League will be adjusted, making it a stepping stone into the regular Arena League. Additionally, one-time milestone rewards will be available for reaching specific ranks.
- Like the regular Arena, the Rookie League will have its own grading system and ranking structure, with rank tallying and victory point compression occurring every two weeks.

2. 10,000-Player Arena Leagues

- Currently, the difficulty of achieving certain Arena grades varies significantly based on server population.
For instance, reaching Punisher ★ requires placing in the top 1,000, making competition much tougher on servers with higher population.
- To address this imbalance, Arena will be restructured into multiple 10,000-player leagues. After each Arena season ends, Summoners will be grouped into leagues of up to 10,000 active players.

For example, if 78,400 Summoners are playing Arena on a server, they will be assigned to one of eight leagues of around 9,800 players.
- With this structure, each league will have its own ranking system to ensure that grade distribution remains consistent across all servers. This means that if a server has eight leagues, it will also have eight Legend players.

3. Arena Tallying & Victory Point Compression Cycle Update

- Currently, Arena tallying is conducted weekly, whereas victory point compression occurs every two weeks. This schedule has caused confusion among Summoners regarding the timing of point compression.

To improve clarity, tallying and compression will now both occur once every two weeks.

- We are also carefully reviewing adjustments to tallying rewards to ensure that their value remains consistent with this new cycle.

4. Arena Interserver Battle Revamp

- Currently, Arena Interserver Battle selects the top 10,000 Arena players from each server, which creates a more competitive environment for highly populated servers.
- To address this, instead of selecting 10,000 players per server, 2,500 players from each league (excluding the Rookie League) will qualify.
We expect this measure to allow more players from densely populated servers to qualify for Arena Interserver Battle and encourage fairer competition among leagues.
- With this change, Arena Interserver Battle will be a showdown between two 2,500-player teams from different servers, instead of a server-wide competition.
- The Interserver Battle schedule, previously spanning five weeks with a three-week break, will now align with the new two-week Arena cycle.
- These changes are scheduled to go live in mid-April, following the conclusion of the current Arena Interserver Battle season.

​

* As Summoners War celebrates its 11th year, we believe it’s time to revisit and improve some of the early Monster models and background art.

1. Monster Model Renewal

- We will gradually update the models of some of the oldest Monsters in the game.
- The first batch includes 13 Monsters: Slime, Shroomy, Surprise Box, Howl, Elemental, Garuda, Inugami, Joker, Vampire, Undine, Dragon, Oracle, and Chimera.
- These updates will not be a one-time renewal but a continuous improvement process, with the next round planned for late 2025.
- Along with visual upgrades, their skill animations will also be improved. However, only base Monster models will be updated, and Transmogrifications will remain unchanged.
- To showcase these updates, please take a look at the before-and-after comparison image.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/88275a3817c3cc6582f1095cb111d6bbf9d7dd58.png

2. Arena Background Art Renewal

- Over the years, we have gradually updated various in-game backgrounds, such as Garen Forest, Mt. Siz, and the Cairos Dungeon update in 2023.
- In April, we will renew the Arena background, including defense towers and mini zoom-in view of defense towers, to enhance the overall Arena experience.



* The Siege Battle map changes, victory point adjustments, and tournament rule updates shared in the first Developer’s Preview are now in the final stages of development. More details will be provided in a dedicated Siege Battle season notice.

* Additionally, two key improvements are in progress, as listed below.

1. First Turn Skill Assignment for Siege Defense Decks

- After testing this feature in Siege Battle Tournaments and Special Matches, we have decided to apply it to the regular Siege Battle season starting late March.
- We will continue to monitor key Siege Battle metrics and refine this feature as needed.

2. Siege Battle Rune Separation Under Review

- We are considering introducing a separate Rune system for Siege Battle to reduce management burden and improve convenience.
- The plan is to add a dedicated Monster menu for Siege Battle, similar to World Arena, allowing unique Rune presets for this mode.
- However, several challenges need to be addressed before we proceed:
1. Increased database load from managing additional Runes.
2. Unlike World Arena, Siege Battle requires storing defense deck Rune data even for inactive players, requiring a different approach.
3. As this development will take time, we will share more details once we finalize a feasible solution and timeline.

We hope you enjoyed the second [Developer’s Preview]!

Our team is working hard to bring fresh energy to Arena and in-game visuals, just as spring breathes fresh energy into the world.

We’ll continue to share our development insights and future direction, while actively listening to your feedback across various community platforms. 

Your input is essential in shaping the future of Summoners War.


Please stay tuned for the next Developer's Preview, covering the 11th Anniversary Update Part 2.



We appreciate your continued love and support, and we look forward to bringing you more exciting updates soon!​

notes.title: [Info] Rune & Artifact Revamp Update Notice
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/2ba225879080fc5c835355b82e741168c0c5d4da.jpg

Greetings from the Summoners War development team!

SWC 2024 will soon reach the finish line, with the world champion to be crowned at the highly anticipated WORLD FINALS on Nov. 8 PST.

We sincerely appreciate your ongoing support, and please join us in cheering on all of the contenders striving to be the best!

The livestream will offer special rewards for viewers, so please tune in.

We'll be giving out special rewards to those who watch the livestream. Also, don't forget to participate in the prediction event for various in-game rewards.

In today's note, we're excited to provide more information about the Rune and Artifact revamp, which was briefly mentioned in the previous dev note.

Our team worked hard on this update to significantly improve the usability and management of Runes and Artifacts.

Please continue reading to explore the new update details.

■ Rune Advanced Settings System

A Rune Advanced Settings feature will be added, a new system designed to help you fine-tune and optimize your Rune setups.

In previous updates, we improved the Rune acquisition by increasing drop rates in Cairos Dungeon, adding new Abyss floors, and allowing Legendary Rune crafting with Rune Essences. We understand that as the supply of high-quality Runes grew, so did the need to manage and use them more effectively.

The Rune Advanced Settings lets you specify desired Rune properties and get recommendations for the best Rune compositions that meet your needs. This eliminates the need for manual Rune comparison, allowing you to easily create more optimized, strategic setups.

You can configure far more detailed settings than the current Rune management system, making it easier to find the ideal Rune combinations for your Monsters or strengthen your existing Runes. This will give you more flexibility and control over your Runes.

Now, we'll go over how to use the Rune Advanced Settings feature.

First, navigate to the Rune Advanced Settings menu. This new feature will be added to the existing [Rune Management] menu, as shown in the screenshot below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/10ebe76808d8ba83b5ce7fb5ba8cae30a7b5cbdb.png

To use Rune Advanced Settings, you need to go over the following steps.

▶ [Rune Advanced Settings] Preparation Steps

Step 1. Select the Monster for the Rune setup.

Either select a Monster from the Rune Management Menu or select a Monster first before entering the Rune Management Menu.

Once you have selected your Monster, enter the [Rune Advanced Settings] menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/435b8c384f7692f51d7dd10c27669ef5b2edfa97.png

You will see the following screen when you enter Rune Advanced Settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/639413a71698d1f050ee11f65ad001d63651fcdb.png

Step 2. Select the desired Rune Sets.

First, select the Rune Sets you want to use. You can combine different sets such as Rage + Blade, or select the same set repeatedly, such as Guard + Guard + Guard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/1382ab651ecdba9ae2fd13c897b09cd28b120e15.png

You can also select only one set and leave the other slots open for any Rune combination. However, you must have four slots (four Runes) selected at the minimum. This means that 4-slot Rune Sets such as Violent or Swift don't require additional selections, but 2-slot Rune Sets such as Shield or Will would need another 2-slot set selected.

Step 3. Set the main property for slots 2, 4, and 6.

For slots 2, 4, and 6, where the main properties are critical, you can pick properties such as ATK, DEF, HP, or SPD based on what your Monster needs. At least two Runes must have a designated main property, while the third Rune can be set to “Any” to allow for more flexible combinations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/76151ce507bbcf770e55742d3fcdd5b1d4e233ca.png

Step 4. Set the target stats.

You can set target stat values based on the combined total of your Monster's base stats and equipped Rune stats. These target stats act as a guide for the system to find the most optimized Rune combinations and will help recommend setups that meet your preferred goals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/dcb9cb1fc23ff27276b0f96ab767ba723d27cdce.png

Step 5. Decide whether to include equipped Runes.

You can choose whether to include Runes already equipped on other Monsters. If you decide to include equipped Runes, the system will be able to offer a wider range of possible options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/422d6a75bdb268d88443c86b3f3ba1b8d8fd36b1.png

This may look a bit confusing at first, but we are sure that this will become easy and handy once you try it out.

Now that we have everything set up, it's time to look at the results.

Press the [Start] button at the bottom of the Rune Advanced Settings screen. The system will then analyze various conditions to recommend the optimized setups.

▶ [Rune Advanced Settings] Results

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/9d15fb86c24205551d662459545c09db16e9dd31.png

The screen above shows a large number of recommended Rune combinations.

If you press each recommended Rune combination, the selected combination will be displayed in the [After] section on the left side of the screen, allowing you to review the details.

The monster's thumbnail is displayed as well if the Runes are equipped on other Monsters.

We are currently preparing to recommend up to 1,000 optimal Rune combinations using Rune Advanced Settings. After reviewing the various combination results, you can select the optimal combination.

We hope this Rune Advanced Settings update will significantly reduce the inconvenience of comparing Runes and designing the best combination one by one.​

■ Monster & Rune & Artifact Share and Recommendation Feature

All Summoners who play Summoners War have most likely sought advice from those around them when they were unsure about the Rune combinations for their Monsters.

We figured that if we could help with these decks or Rune settings in the game, it would be a huge help for new Summoners to enjoy Summoners War even more.

This new feature will allow you to share your Monster, Rune, and Artifact status 1:1 and receive deck or Rune/Artifact recommendations.

Summoners can get recommendations for Monster combinations and Rune/Artifact settings that suit them from friends, guild members, and mentors/mentees.

When you're not sure which Monster combination is best for battle or need the best Rune settings for a specific situation, use the "Deck Recommendation" feature to get advice and recommendations!

We'll walk you through the new deck recommendation UI step by step, with images.

▶ Requesting Deck Recommendations

Press the new Deck button added to the [Community] menu. This will send a request to receive deck recommendations to friends, guild members, and mentors/mentees.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/866b794390b0e32c9435530e4d22619b2f5a0de9.png

You will see the following screen when you press the Deck button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/f3b076e8a9155cf3d03a6cd8dbe4043ce0fc1d56.png

Here, the menu presents two tabs: Sent and Received.

The more detailed your request, the better advice the Summoner receiving the request will be able to provide.

▶ Replying to Deck Recommendation Requests

A Summoner who receives a deck recommendation request can review the requesting Summoner’s Monsters and equipped Runes and Artifacts. After that, the Summoner can set up a deck for recommendation.

You can set up the deck and Runes for the Monsters in a format like this.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/413cdc34b08f560e93440253a4ac5d285b57f036.png

Up to 6 Monsters can be recommended in a deck, but you can also suggest just one, allowing for flexible responses based on the situation.

▶ Using Completed Deck Recommendations

You can view completed deck recommendations in the Community menu as shown below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/191f86f4a6eeaaec6ba25f0c97754f48feba864f.png

Press the menu to check the recommended deck composition and Rune/Artifact setup, and then immediately apply the recommended settings to your deck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/d5dbc1f14b50db041196e6a9aab8db1e91ff0799.png

You can send up to 5 deck recommendation requests at a time.

We hope this new feature will be another helpful and fun feature for those who are looking for different setups and recommendations and those who like sharing their strategies to help other Summoners.

■ Rune & Artifact Score System

A new score system that shows the performance of Runes and Artifacts at a glance will be added.
You can check the score in the info pop-up of Runes or Artifacts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/2aee5f4ff1ed996e61d6ea0aa042601a4c249be5.png

This system assigns a score to each Rune and Artifact based on its property values, allowing Summoners to easily assess its quality.

Many of you will agree that it's important to carefully evaluate how the property values are applied when obtaining Runes and Artifacts.

You can now quickly evaluate the quality of the Rune/Artifact using the score instead of comparing each property individually.

When you acquire or power up Runes, those with higher property values receive higher scores, while ones with lower property values receive lower scores.

This will help you easily decide whether to sell or power up a Rune based on its score. It will also help you manage your inventory more effectively by organizing low-score Runes and keeping high-score Runes.

This will distinguish the difference in Rune quality after powering up a high-score Rune, allowing you to quickly assess how much the Rune has improved from the power-up.

Next, we will discuss the changes to crafting in the Craft Building.

■ Legend Rune Crafting Revamp

Since its introduction in the 2023 RELOADED update, the Rune Essence crafting item has been extremely useful for crafting Legend Runes.

To make better use of these valuable Rune Essences, we’re excited to announce improvements to Legend Rune crafting.

The upcoming update will allow you to gain more control over Legend Rune crafting. You can now select not only the Rune Set but also the Rune slot number and main property by using additional Rune Essences. This update aims to provide more options, enabling you to craft more specific Runes that match your needs.

You can either craft a Rune with random properties as before or, by using more essences, craft a Rune with your desired set, slot, and main property.

As shown in the image below, you will still use the Legend Rune crafting menu in the Craft Building.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/87d216b727abf537d55475343f72bcda2fccb1e9.png

The amount of Rune Essences will differ according to the options you select. The more options you select, the more essences you will use to craft.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/182150f2c6ce9421c66ba8f1240c1ee9205865b5.png

■ Legend Artifact Crafting and Artifact Essence

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/a9157558d0e3e9c3d54497129775be9287f6ad97.png

The addition of Legend Artifact Crafting comes with the new material, Artifact Essences. Artifact Essence works similarly to Rune Essence and can be obtained by selling Rare or higher-grade Artifacts with a fixed chance. When selling Legend Artifacts, you will be guaranteed to earn 10 Artifact Essences.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/17d3b7a9daad0f958b97780a008abea36b84c2eb.png

Like the revamped Legend Rune Crafting, Legend Artifact Crafting allows you to select specific options, and the crafting cost increases based on the options you choose. You can select a desired attribute or type of Artifact, then specify one category within that, and even select the main property to craft.

Please note that like the Rune crafting, you will need to use more Artifact Essences if you have more options selected.

The cost for crafting Legend Artifacts is as follows:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/6541d08042af6de36c6a02d15e15acb72cabab94.png

■ Mid Rune Crafting Removed

With the most recent update, 5★ Runes will no longer appear in [High Rune Crafting] and [Ancient Rune Crafting], making it easier for Summoners to obtain higher-grade Runes.

As a result, the role of [Mid Rune Crafting] has become increasingly ambiguous, and the frequency in which it is used has decreased significantly.

To simplify the crafting system and provide a better experience for Summoners, we have decided to remove the [Mid Rune Crafting] function.

■ New Ancient Gem/Grindstone Crafting

Summoners can now craft Ancient Gem and Ancient Grindstone with Ancient Magic Stones from the 2nd Awakening Dungeon and Rune Ores from each dimension area.

The new Ancient Gem/Grindstone crafting method is the same as the current Ancient Rune crafting method. Because existing Ancient Rune materials are also used as crafting materials, it is important to focus on resource management for efficient crafting.

■ [Dimension Hole] Rune Drop Rate Increased

We received a very positive response from our Summoners after introducing Harpu's 2nd Awakening and the Dimensional Hole Charge Increase update in the v.8.5.0 update.

We'd like to boost Rune drop rate to make this content even more meaningful.

5★ Ancient Runes will no longer drop from Lv. 5 Dimension Dungeons, leaving only 6★ Ancient Runes. The chances of dropping a higher-grade Ancient Rune will increase.

■ MAX Slots for Runes, Gems & Grindstones, Artifacts, and Engraved Conversion Stones Increased

The v8.1.4 update in November 2023 increased the number of repeat battles in Cairos Dungeon to 30. We also improved the drop rate, resulting in a significant increase in the acquisition of Runes and Artifacts, particularly 6★ Hero+ Runes.

After nearly a year, we have taken into account Summoners' higher expectations and believe it is time to shift our focus away from simply increasing quantity to improving the chances of obtaining high-quality Runes. In addition, we wanted to make it easier to equip Monsters with desired Runes and Artifacts as well as manage unnecessary Runes and Artifacts.

The main goal of this update is to improve the quality of Rune acquisition and management. However, we acknowledged that storage slot expansion is critical to alleviating the stress caused by limited slots, regardless of how much the quality improves.

As millions of Summoners farm and store items, the strain on servers increases. Thus, we’re introducing paid slot expansions alongside free expansions to better manage this load.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/28fc540577fb144ae3cabde41f58249ed964af1d.png

We plan to expand Runes by 300 slots, Artifacts by 500 slots, and Gems/Grindstones and Engraved Conversion Stones by 1,000 slots for free.

Crystal expansions are additional to these free slots.
For Runes, you'll receive 1,500 free slots and can expand 500 more using Crystals.

This is all we have for today's dev note.

The coming update will offer more improvements that were not discussed in this note, so please look forward to it.

The update discussed today will be released by the end of October.


We will be back with more exciting news!

Thank you.​

notes.title: [Info] v8.5.0 Update and New 2nd Awakening Monster Notice
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/346b0efcc3da2b204e29e99e304e07ff86c1c285.jpg

Greetings from the Summoners War Dev Team!

Before we begin with today's dev note, we want to thank everyone for your incredible interest and support in the Jujutsu Kaisen collaboration.
This was our first time working with an anime, so it was exciting but also challenging. We were able to successfully carry out the collaboration thanks to our Summoners.
We'll be pushing forward to make more new and helpful updates to the game based on your suggestions and thoughts.

Now, let's get into our next exciting update, which includes the new 2nd Awakening Monster.

===================================================

▶ New 2nd Awakening Monster
First, take a look at the image of the new 2A Monster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/40e633526a1ae5347c46bcd93f0032a2a0dc4231.jpg

As you can see, the next Monster to join the 2A Monster family is [Harpu].
Unlike her original look, we tried to bring out more charisma and regal presence.
2A [Harpu] will be available as the third member of Dimension Lumel.

As you know, 2A not only enhances the Monster's look but also its skills. In this note, we will give you a sneak peek of the skill set of one of five attributes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/871daeebc28b427d48113e3460f8576cd9bc1aa7.png
* This cooldown is based on the MAX skill level.

The dev team took extra attention to its third skill, [Violent Friends]. The skill is changed from attacking solo to attacking with other allies, which suits the skill name more perfectly.
We believe that this 2A will open up more strategic gameplay options for many of you and utilize the Dark Harpu, and other four attributes, even more in the battlefield.

With this update, we'll be increasing the Dimension Hole Energy recharge limit from 3 to 5 times per week. This will fasten your progress of 2nd Awakening the Monsters.

Here’s some info on the stage setup for the 2nd Awakening Dungeon, where you’ll be able to 2nd Awaken Harpu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/d0a2d2578bcb1a45476099c23454d2e8dc691fb3.png

Now that we went over the 2A Harpu, here are some other details that will be introduced to the game with the update.

​▶ v.8.5.0 Update Preview

▶ [Siege Battle] Support Monsters
The Support Monster feature, which is available in World Arena, will now be added to Siege Battle as well.
We hope this will be a great help for new Summoners and those with limited Monster pools, which will eventually lead them to be more engaged in Siege Battle and contribute more to their guild's success.

▶ What are Support Monsters?
Each season, 10 Monsters are available for use in Siege Battle, even if you don’t own them.
These Support Monsters can only be used for attacks and are not available for defense teams.

The provided Monsters come fully leveled up, equipped with Runes and Artifacts balanced for optimal performance. Please note that you cannot change or remove Runes and Artifacts equipped on them.
There will be one set of Support Monsters throughout each season. However, we will provide the same set of Support Monsters for 16th and 17th seasons.

Here is the list of Support Monsters for this season, along with their equipped Rune sets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/02913ff7fabae4282c2d5de3985bdd7abddd9140.png

▶ How to Use Support Monsters

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/a40197bc8fb5411a227b949c108c82234a4e710c.png

Go to [Siege Battle Battlefield > Support] to see the list of Support Monsters of the season.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/cfe3912d2b2776f21c58681130de62600433cc8e.png

You can review the 10 Support Monsters and select the ones you want to register. Keep in mind that you can utilize all 10 of them.

Once registered, you can select your Support Monsters from the battle preparation screen. Use them to form powerful strategies and try out various tactics to match the battle situation.

Here’s a summary of the Siege Battle Support Monster feature:

▶ What are Siege Battle Support Monsters?
- Each season, 10 Monsters (5★ Monster x6, 4★ monsters x 4) are provided.
- Support Monsters can only be used for attacks and are not available for defense teams.
- You can use multiple Support Monsters in a single battle.
- Each Support Monster can be used only once.
- You can also use Support Monsters in test battles.

▶ Attack Speed Display Settings
To help Summoners prepare more strategically, we’re introducing a new feature that will allow you to check the final Attack Speed of your Monsters in the battle preparation screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/829712cde0a7dcf31d6a608c432bc6e4d23909e4.png

As shown in the above image, the area in the battle preparation screen that previously displayed the Monster's level will now show the Monster's Attack Speed instead.

This Attack Speed reflects the total value after factoring in equipped Runes, Artifacts, leader skills, guild skills, and Summoner skills, up to 3 digits.

All effects related to Attack Speed will be applied in real time, allowing you to see the Monster's final Attack Speed during battle preparation.
For example, if you set a Monster with a leader skill that increases ally Monsters’ Attack Speed, the final Attack Speed applied with this effect will be displayed.

This will allow you to check the Attack Speed of your Monsters in real time, helping you to prepare for battles more efficiently,

This feature will be available as an option in the Monster sorting/search menu at the bottom of the battle preparation screen. You’ll be able to enable it in the settings, alongside the Attribute Mark Mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/4e8ea4f86ab50fc291bd735d629c9e085920fcec.png

If any of your Monsters don’t have Runes or Artifacts equipped, an unequipped icon will be displayed in place of the Attack Speed. This will help you quickly identify incomplete battle preparations. Monsters without Runes or Artifacts won’t have their Attack Speed displayed, so be sure to double-check before heading into battle.

▶ High Rune Crafting Improvements: Only 6★ Runes
We’ve made several improvements over time to help Summoners farm better Runes, including the Cairos Dungeon Abyssal floor update and Rune drop rate improvements.
In line with these changes, we’ve decided it’s time to improve the efficiency of Rune crafting as well. So with the v8.5.0 update, only 6★ Runes will be crafted through High Rune Crafting.

This change will be helpful for new Summoners who are still building up their Rune collection. We hope this will help many of them obtain the 6★ Runes they need.

In addition to this change, we are excited to let you know that we will be bringing a variety of improvements to both Runes and Artifacts in the upcoming v8.5.1 update at the end of October.
We’ll share more details about these improvements, so please stay tuned and look forward to the v8.5.1 update.

We also have one more piece of news about the upcoming v8.5.1 update.

▶ Battle Training Grounds Revamp
The current Battle Training Ground has a fixed set of skills and order, which forces a specific playstyle, often missing the original intent of this feature.
We’re preparing changes that will make the Battle Training Ground more engaging by allowing you to experience key battle elements such as turn coordination between Monsters, attribute relations, and buff/debuff mechanics—all while having fun strategizing.

To do this, we’ll be removing all existing stages and introducing new ones designed to enhance your experience.
Please note that the current Battle Training Ground will be removed with the v8.5.1 update at the end of October.

That's all for today's dev note. We hope you are excited to enjoy the new 2A Monster and others we are working on.

This dev note is intended to help you understand the upcoming update in advance. As development and testing are still underway, we ask you to understand that the actual update may differ from what we shared in this note.

Before we end the note, we’d like to share some news about SWC2024.

First, we sincerely thank all Summoners for the interest and support shown for SWC2024.
The preliminaries and EUROPE CUP have ended successfully, and we have two more Regional Cups left until the WORLD FINALS.
AMERICAS CUP will be held on Oct. 12 (local time) and ASIA-PACIFIC CUP on Oct. 25 (local time), so please stay tuned.
To enhance your fun watching the SWC2024, we encourage you to participate in the  and obtain various rewards.

We would like to also thank all the contenders of SWC2024, and we ask for your continued support for the upcoming Regional Cups and the WORLD FINALS.

We will be back soon with more exciting update news!​

notes.title: [Info] v8.3.9 Update Developer's Note
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/7789d59d1412d748bf27b582049ab6f384c45257.jpg

Greetings from the Summoners War Dev Team!

In today's note, we would like to talk about the upcoming update: Guild Battle Research.

As many of you agree, battle is one of the core aspects of Summoners War.
Guild PvP content such as Siege Battle and World Guild Battle offers immersive gameplay where your guild can elaborate on various decks and strategies to win against opposing guilds.

We are introducing a new feature called Guild Battle Research. With this, you will be able to study various decks and discuss strategies with guild members more easily.

Let's dive into the details below.

===================================================

What's Guild Battle Research?
It's a guild-exclusive feature where you can run test battles in an environment similar to an actual battle, allowing you to study and discuss various decks with guild members.

▶ Experiment Freely
Build and test defense and offense decks using Monsters you don’t own. See how your dream decks perform in practice.

▶ No Rune and Artifact Removal Costs
Equip and swap Runes and Artifacts freely without any cost.
Note that these changes are temporary and only apply within the Guild Battle Research menu.

▶ Store Up to 100 Defense Decks
Your guild can save up to 100 defense decks, enabling extensive strategy testing and refinement.

▶ Share Research and Feedback
Conduct battle research and leave up to 30 replays and comments per defense deck, fostering in-depth discussion and improvement within your guild.

===================================================

We believe that the ability to design and test decks using Monsters you don't own will be a useful tool, giving you a strategic advantage in guild PvP content such as Siege Battle and World Guild Battle.

Now, let's look at how you can use the Guild Battle Research feature in detail.

▶ New Feature: [Guild Battle Research]
The new Guild Battle Research feature can be accessed via Guild Tower.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/8607db7d15ef5b109bc14d3dc28b3b71a9e90ca1.png

Here, you can see a new [Battle Research] button added to the Guild Tower menu.
When you tap this button, you will see the following screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/1339e7203ae0cc34cc439937778844b6d31e69d6.png

The screen displays defense decks with strategy details and comments on how to improve the decks.
This was prepared to allow Summoners to freely share their thoughts, effective tactics, and areas for improvement when trying out the defense decks.

Now, let's go over the extensive menus and demonstrate how to use the feature.

▶ Register Defense Decks
Tap the [Battle Research] menu to see the following pop-up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/961402278843b3a963bc8aa478cbbb0dd9f04898.png

You will see an empty pop-up for now since there are no defense decks registered. Now, let's tap the Register Defense Deck button.

▶ STEP 1. Place Monsters in the defense placement screen.
Tap the [Guild Battle Research > Register Defense Deck] to see the following defense placement screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/7552687c0050547eb59ec347ac2244e65f59c987.png

As mentioned earlier, you can also place Monsters you don't own.
Tap the button displayed on the screen to see the Monster selection screen and add Monsters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/2d1674b4e6d8613c6e30d15bcda390dca204b643.png

The added Monsters will be 6-starred Monsters with MAX level and MAX skill levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/6655a237cf9651233666ac8e8987e08fca499143.png

Once the Monsters are placed, the [Rune/Artifact Settings] button will be activated in the [Defense Placement] screen.

▶ STEP 2. Set up Runes and Artifacts of the placed Monsters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/134ccc3e23f2ab98632cd7d57c4b1732ebe111f5.png

You can set up three Monsters in a defense deck at once, and the Monsters will have their current Runes and Artifacts engraved initially.
You can also load Runes/Artifacts engraved on other Monsters.
Once you've completed all of the settings, you'll return to the defense placement screen and register the defense deck.

▶ STEP 3. Register the defense deck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/044312c4f9ede99ea5ae5d38be6b3328a7627821.png

Tap the [Register] button, and you will see a screen asking you to enter the title of the defense deck. Enter the title and the defense deck will be registered.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/fd35f97611fb091f4bcfe30a2fa00d89c5c2ef8d.png

Here shows the registered defense deck.

In summary, you will go through three steps to register a defense deck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/2cf52bf61c8cff6bc16311e53e9f1dae8a16bd2f.jpg

You can go through various tests with registered defense decks, which we will go over below.

▶ Battle Research and Feedback

When you select a registered defense deck, the above menu will be displayed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/545b2cffcaa87c2c0c6852b3492ecf9c01e08b78.png

You can enter the Battle Research menu or select Monsters to use for an offense deck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/51a24940ec009827d8655b1229a63a4e90d5d0f9.png

When conducting battle research, you can set the Monster's Runes and Artifacts in the same way as you do for the defense deck.
Of course, you can use Monsters that you don't own in battle.

When you finish battle research, a button to make a comment will appear on the battle results screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/5451a0a5521f3f37dc48e8e52de8df6d41f3b883.png

The [Share to Guild] button allows you to leave comments, replays, and details regarding the defense deck under Guild Battle Research > Defense Deck, as seen below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/2f67ecf8e6daee9f40a883eb7d09723a5f47cdad.png

If you simply wish to play a battle without leaving a record of your battle research, tap on the [Quit] button on the battle results screen.

You can also post comments on the defense deck without engaging in battle.
Tap the [Feedback] button on the Guild Battle Research > Defense Deck screen to select a Monster or simply add comments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/8a92c615e18168abf70763ce600a07d316b5c1e6.png

We've covered the steps for registering a defense deck, researching registered defense decks, and leaving comments. We believe that this new feature will help many in finding ways to counter decks, improve defense decks, and more.

We are already excited to see Summoners using this feature to create a page full of rich tactics.

​▶ Other Details

▷ One guild can register and manage up to 100 defense decks, and each defense deck can save up to 30 replays and feedback.
(Please note that the save limit per deck is shared by all guild members.)

When your guild has 100 defense decks, no more decks can be registered. You must delete the existing defense decks to register new ones.
This also means that you can have only up to 30 replays/feedback per deck, and you must delete the existing replay/feedback to add new ones.
Only you, Guild Master, and Vice Guild Masters can delete the registered defense decks. Please communicate with your guildmates to manage the defense decks.

▷ Guild Tower > Replay will be improved.
- A [Battle Test] replay tab will be added, allowing you to see the replays of battle tests separately.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/92b69375072578ad9bf58037a91b288c73af6de4.png

​- You can now leave comments on replays of Siege Battle and battle test.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/036a0541e6fe7820deaf29a137bb5648cf88ac25.png

The UI will be modified so that comments can be added when sharing Siege Battle replays after the battle is over. Leave battle information in the comments section and share it with guild members alongside the replay.

Lastly, we would like to discuss the features that will be added and modified along with Guild Battle Research.

▶ [Siege Battle Season 16] New Battlefield
The Siege Battle has undergone numerous changes since its initial update in 2017, including the addition of the Siege Battle Tournament, special rules, and the Punisher grade.
The battleground, one of the most essential aspects of Siege Battle, will be changed in the next season.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/33e39ab476160da3ab2dcd736e84fa3b4be9b25c.png

The image above shows that many portions of the current battlefield have changed.

The number of bases adjacent to opposing guilds has increased from five to seven. We predict more intense fights to break out as more bases face opposing guilds. The key is to firmly protect your guild's frontline while occupying the bases of opposing guilds.

The base in the center, connected to both the HQ and several frontline bases, is connected to six bases of your guild. In other words, the central base may as well be the most vital base for your guild. Protecting this base will be another key to victory.

Because of this modification in the battleground, we expect to see many new methods and tactics that differ from those used in the current Siege Battle.
We hope that the addition of the Guild Battle Research feature, as well as the modifications to the battlefield, will bring new changes and vigor to battle.

We are also considering modifying the design of the battleground at a later point, if necessary. We intend to update the battlefield design on an irregular basis in preparation for new strategies to be deployed in Siege Battle.

▶ [Monster Subjugation] Battle Time Change
The Monster Subjugation battle time will change in the v.8.3.9 update. The current battle lasts 24 hours in total, 12 hours each for first round and second round.
We received feedback from Summoners who were unable to engage in the current Monster Subjugation battle due to its short duration.
We'd like to make adjustments so that more Summoners can enjoy the content by increasing its duration from 12 to 24 hours.

The change in battle time will take effect from the Monster Subjugation taking place the week after the update. We are currently working on v.8.3.9 to be released on Jul. 12th. Based on this timeline, Monster Subjugation that begins after Jul. 15th will have each round lasting 24 hours.
We anticipate that more Summoners will be able to engage in the Monster Subjugation which will now last for a total of 48 hours.

This is all we have for today's note.
We hope that you are excited to see the features mentioned in the game soon.

The dev note is intended to help you understand the upcoming update in advance.
As development and testing are still underway, we ask you to understand that the actual update may differ from what we shared in this note.

We will be back with another exciting dev note soon!
Thank you.

The process won't take long, but you may experience a sudden crash if you are logged in when the update begins.
Please make sure to come back to the Village and end your game safely to save your game data before the update starts.

Global - 12:45am PDT 
Europe - 9:45am CEST 
Asia - 3:30pm TST 
Korea - 4pm KST 
Japan - 4:30pm JST 
China - 3:30pm CST

=====================================
v8.3.6 Update Details 
=====================================​​​​​​​

▶ Fire Magic Knight [Vengeful Fire (Passive)] Skill Balance Adjusted
- Increases your Attack Power for 1 turn (once per turn) → Increases your Attack Power by 150% until the next turn if you receive damage from an enemy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/12b4aecbf483bfecd48cb6cd5bcb80eb4d704a74.png

▶ [Challenge of Ascension] Maximum Floor Expanded

※ The ranking is not refreshed in real-time and it may take some time to apply the latest information.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/c3a132783da1de541489f4651f0c0eeb140dd454.png

- A [First Conqueror] menu that shows the first clear record of your server has been added to the [Ranking] menu.

When certain floors of Spires of Ascension and each Attribute Tower are cleared for the first time in the server, all Summoners of that server can claim the same reward from the [First Conqueror] menu once.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/993ca0d24a077863f3e35401d48433bc2530238f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/452edcbfde3203e8f3d3e634d190d89b9867520b.png

- Go to [Defense] or [Member > Battle Info > Place Defense] and enter the Test menu located on the top-right side to try out the special rules.

▶ The skill balance of some Monsters was adjusted.
[View Details]

▶ [Siege Battle] UI / Menu Added for Battle Statistics Overview

- You can view the aggregate battle record of all guild members for the current battle through the UI added to 

[Battle Status] and [Siege Battle Info > Battle Record > Battle Info].

: The information on Attack/Defense attempts and success rates and Monster usage data will be displayed.

: You can filter the records by the opponent guilds currently on the battlefield.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/0db45e55983b8ee87efe3d884800aa589bb4d344.png

you can only display the number of successful Attack/Defense attempts and hide the success rates and Monster usage data.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/84b3aade174749e1711edf5040091d02597baa98.png

※ Battle records will be saved based on the season data and will be available for Siege Battles held after the v8.3.4 update.


▶ [Siege Battle] Searching Formation by Monsters

- You can sort defense formations saved in the HQ by Monsters using the new Monster search feature added to the HQ Support screen.

: You can select a Monster and sort only the formations that include the selected Monster. Up to three Monsters can be selected.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/14aa79a9176faf3dc21d0f7073ab4409393e32ec.png

▶ [Siege Battle / World Guild Battle] Notification for Monsters without Runes/Artifacts

- A notification icon will be displayed if Monsters without Runes/Artifacts engraved are placed in

the bases of [Siege Battle / World Guild Battle] or your [Defense > Place Defense].

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/26e3290f63fce4291b71a5cb8c9b750076fe3641.png

- [Siege Battle] If Monsters without Runes/Artifacts engraved are placed in a defense formation when you are trying to move it to a base,

you can notify the guild member who set up the formation via Private Chat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/4e0c9966f5fb488a44df5e4355324bf5e861e090.png


▶ [World Guild Battle] Best Record Added / Modified

- [User Profile] "Guild Battle" under Best Score has changed to "World Guild Battle."

- [Guild Info] Best World Guild Battle info has been added.

※ Best record for World Guild Battle will be displayed after the first tallying period of the World Guild Battle held after the v8.3.4 update.

Only the guild members who participated in the World Guild Battle after the update as Attack/Defense members will be displayed.


▶ [Load Runes/Artifacts] Feature Added

- A button for [Load Runes/Artifacts] has been added to the Monster info window that opens in the battle preparation screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/66533e1f174283800ee397d44264a42b199db6ff.png


- You can tap on the [Load Runes/Artifacts] button to select a Monster from the list

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/f32d5935b66eeb6904bb79e5a09b21d474044fe8.png


※ If you select a Monster of the same Attribute/Type, you will also load its Artifacts.

If you select a Monster of a different Attribute/Type, only its Runes will be loaded,

but if there is an Artifact of the same Attribute/Type, you can load it by checking [Load Artifacts Too]. 



▶ [Rune, Artifact, Gem/Grindstone Manage] Sorting Feature Improved

- [Rune Manage / Artifact Manage] You can sort Runes/Artifacts based on the sum of the Sub Property values. 

※ Sub Property values are calculated based on the maximum value that can be added to the Rune/Artifact from power-ups.

(Excludes values amplified by Grindstones)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/bd7808425e074cae262839fedcafdb481246d08f.png



- You can sort results in ascending/descending order in [Rune Manage], [Artifact Manage], and [Gem/Grindstone Manage].

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/97aa9eaec81ba1f5882afd69270b84063a91128f.png



▶ [Monster Marker] Related Features Improved

- [World Arena] Monster marker button has been added.

- [Battle Preparation Screen] You can sort Monsters by "By Marker" in the Manage Monster Deck pop-up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/32837e69d63770e35ab2838f021529afcce1db41.png


- A confirmation pop-up will no longer appear when you set or remove a marker.
