- You can view each floor's information through the "Strategy Info" button added on the UI of Challenge of Ascension.

: You can view the information of Monsters and the Boss that appear in each floor's waves. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/d3530406dacaa3e4d578fe2388b2094886146028.png


- Other related improvements have been implemented.

: Even if the previous battle was completed in Auto mode, the next battle you enter will start in Manual mode.

: [World Map > Challenge of Ascension] Users who have not unlocked Challenge of Ascension will also be able to view the selection screen.

: The skill effect animation of some Monsters on certain floors has been improved.

※ The ranking addition and floor expansion in Challenge of Ascension has been rescheduled for the first update of June.

We ask for your kind understanding.



▶ Guild Administrators can send private messages to Summoners who have requested to join the guild.

- Guild Administrators can send the message to Summoners in the list under "In Progress."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/e491d8f15677f436d9404166d5c37ed0c1622c44.png


- The Summoner who received the private message can reply, and they can select each other in the Select User menu in Chat.

- They will be able to share the Monster and Rune info with one another.

- If the Summoner is removed from the list under In Progress due to a canceled/denied request or from joining a different guild,

the Summoner and Guild Administrator will no longer have each other under the chat list or be able to share Monster/Rune information.


▶ [Guild Megaphone] Modified

- The cost of Guild Megaphones has been changed as below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/3ffc04a0b67ecc1e0b51219fb57e6d45a441be3d.png


- The time limit for using [Guild Megaphones] will be shared by all guild members.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/ed880fe714ea02c5adb21c05f1592a4081b8e309.png

: This notification can be turned ON/OFF by going to [Settings > Options > Push Notification > Detailed Settings].

- The grade of Runes given as day 3 and day 9 rewards of [New Summoner Welcome Special Reward] has been raised.

: (Day 3) Rare Rune x3 → Hero Rune x3 / (Day 9) Rare Rune x5 → Hero Rune x5

※ You can collect the changed rewards after the v8.3.4 update if you have not collected the reward.

You can collect the rewards retroactively if you have purchased the New Summoner Check-in Pass.

- Products available once per account that are displayed based on the game progress can be found in [Shop > Limited > Account Limited Pack].

: The tab is visible only if the products are. You can also find products that were displayed in [Efficient > Growth Pack] in [Account Limited Pack].

▶ Game Error Fixes

- Fixed an error where the [Guardian of the Pharaoh Desert Queen] transmog appeared abnormal when [Gladiator of Wrath] was applied.

- Fixed an error where the passive skill scripts for Lyrith (10F) and Ath'taros (20F) in the five Attribute Towers were displayed incorrectly

in [Settings (cog wheel) > Monster Info] at the bottom of the battle screen.​

Q. What are the conditions for summoning 10 Monsters?
A. The summon will proceed based on the activation status of the Monster collection. 10 default 5★ Fire/Water/Wind Monsters you have never summoned will be summoned at random with a fixed chance. You may summon the same type of Monster in different attributes, but the same Monster with the same attribute will not be summoned more than once.

Q. How do I check the Monsters that I haven't summoned before? If I unsummoned a Monster in the past, can I summon that Monster with this scroll?
A. The acquisition will be determined based on the activation status in your Monster collection menu. Since the unsummoned Monsters count as activated in the collection, the unsummoned Monsters will not be summoned again.

notes.title: [Info] v8.2.6 Update Developer's Note
notes.notes:
Greetings from the Summoners War Dev Team!

Before we dive into the details, we first want to thank every one of you for showing such great support and interest in our collaboration with The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt.

Gwent, in particular, received many positive feedback from our Summoners - so we would like to talk first about the Gwent update that will be available via v8.2.6 update.

▶ Free Mode - Play Gwent repeatedly without limits!

With this Free Mode, you can play Gwent continuously, allowing you to try out different decks and fun elements.

In each battle, you will face an opponent with random factions, skills and card decks.

This means that there will be a variety of decks composed in the Free Mode. Your key to victory will be analyzing the opponent's deck and operating your deck strategically.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/0421ec76dc6872ef96863483f772f4fcc9717fb8.png

Free Mode is added to the menu where the weeks are displayed, and the game rules stay the same.

You will earn a small amount of Mana Stones as a victory reward.

We've prepared this Free Mode so you can play against different decks in a more enjoyable way, so please try out the new mode and play Gwent!

▶ New Stage Limit Condition

As you clear Gwent week by week, you will see your Gwent card collection filling up.

You would probably have all the cards by clearing up to Week 6.

Starting Week 7 (Mar. 11th), we want to add a limit condition for each stage to give a twist to your play environment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/84087407aa6c6caf1013bbb472f79b8a797c09c6.png

We intended to improve Gwent by adding Free Mode and new play conditions so that Summoners can continue to enjoy the game in a new context.

Try playing Gwent while using various cards featuring Summoners War's unique Monsters.

Now, we would like to discuss the main update features that will also be available via v8.2.6 update.

▶ Rune QoL Improvement

: [Rune Management] A sub-property search feature will be improved to help you find Runes easier and faster.

: [Rune Selling Exclusion Settings] You can now set up the Rune selling exclusion settings with the main property and Rune number.

▶ Hall of Heroes Available While the Repeat Battle is On

▶ [Cairos Dungeon] Abyssal Floor is No Longer Seasonal Content

We will walk you through each main feature discussed above, starting with the Rune QoL.

■ Rune QoL Improvement

▶ [Rune Management] A sub-property search feature will be improved to help you find Runes easier and faster.

: You can now select up to 4 sub properties, and a feature that allows you to search based on the sub property's stats will also be added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/232b7ca4ad6116fb1c55e2a1c4a956fe3f7caabf.png

As you can see in the image above, a screen UI will be changed to display up to 4 sub properties selected.

You may have noticed that sub properties also have detailed numerical values displayed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/b88fc38bfd4ad09fd96d5363149c4b7395aa353f.png

With the new sub property detailed search pop-up, you can search for Runes by type, priority and numerical value of each sub property.

The priorities of each sub property are searched in the order of 1 - 4, and the sub properties with the highest priority are applied in the search results.

▶ [Rune Management] You can now select multiple Rune sets to search.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/73feacfeec15a331f7ba7345f73fc1d341f08ef9.png

Right now, you can select either one set or all sets to search.

With the new update, you will be able to select multiple sets of your choice to search Runes.

▶ [Rune Management] "Don't show this again today" checkbox is added to the confirmation pop-up that shows when changing Runes.

▶ [Rune Selling Exclusion Settings] You can now set up the Rune selling exclusion settings with the main property and Rune number.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/5b4b321798f43fbbade9186c946a6cfbc53d8b15.png

In order to enable more exact and detailed filtering, we've introduced settings for the main properties and each rune number.

▶ [Rune Selling Exclusion Settings] Tabs in use / not in use can be distinguished based on the setting status.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/16e74d0b9054ec5b53aae750a6297610d93340d0.png

Improvements have been made to identify tabs with the current settings saved and tabs that are deactivated due to no sell exclusion settings.

Following the v8.1.4 update, the drop rate of Runes in Cairos Dungeon increased greatly. And the importance of the Rune management function used for searching and selling the Runes you acquire has also increased greatly.

We intend to continue to consider and create enhancements to the Rune management function so that you can handle Runes easily even after this update.

We will now update you on changes to the structure of the Hall of Heroes.

■ Hall of Heroes can be played while you run the Repeat Battle.

Hall of Heroes is a limited-time dungeon that opens once a month in Cairos Dungeon, which is frequently played by Summoners whenever it is available.

We will be improving this dungeon so it can be played while you are running other dungeons through the Repeat Battle.

▶ An icon is exposed in the battle world map when the Hall of Heroes is open.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/15fa1729f4978095a95f90d208ef75ff3db56e64.png

As you can see, Hall of Heroes can be entered through a separate icon menu, similar to the World Boss menu, instead of from the list of dungeons in Cairos Dungeon.

▶ You can now enter and play in the Hall of Heroes while running the Repeat Battle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/d11eb210f78ba92c3cc7a7632c791fc32369d94b.png

You will be able to auto battle from 1st floor to 10th floor. It's similar to you playing in the Trial of Ascension while running the Repeat Battle.

You can play each floor manually or go from the 1st to 10th floors in auto while the Repeat Battle is on.

This feature will be applied starting from the March Hall of Heroes.

■​ [Cairos Dungeon] Abyssal Floor is No Longer Seasonal Content

We informed you about the seasonal system of Abyssal Floor from the RELOADED notice and dev notes.

We've been paying close attention to see if the Abyssal Floor update is happening too frequently, if the difficulty and rewards are balanced, and even more, if the seasonal system is suitable for the content.

We constantly improved the content by adjusting the update cycle, difficulty and rewards via the second major update and v8.1.4 update, and thought that now was the appropriate time to discuss the seasonal system in depth.

In the instance of Cairos Dungeon Rune farming, which is one of our game's fundamental features, we believe the best course of action is to build a solid deck and then evolve it into a deck that can clear dungeons faster.

When designing and growing a deck like this, there are contradictory components of the dungeon's concept that change at regular intervals. We were worried if this would detract Summoners from enjoying and developing the clear deck.

As a result, we believed that allowing Summoners to build a deck to fight against bosses and then evolve it into a more advanced deck would make the Abyssal Floor more enjoyable.

After considering this, we would like to change the Abyssal Floor to a non-seasonal system similar to the remaining floors of the Cairos Dungeon, allowing Summoners to continue to improve their deck based on their current strategy deck.

Instead, we intend to give Summoners with the enjoyment of constructing new decks and overcoming stages via distinct content updates other than the Cairos Dungeon.

This is all we have for today's note.

The details discussed today will be available via v8.2.6 update, so please stay tuned.

(This note is intended to help you understand the upcoming update in advance. As development and testing are still underway, we ask you to understand that the actual update may differ from what we shared in this note.)

We will continue to consider and work on numerous enhancements so that Summoners can have a more enjoyable playing experience.

We are continually listening to Summoners' voices and working to improve the game, so we would appreciate it if you could provide feedback through various channels.


Thank you.​

: Rewards excluding Guild EXP can be collected only once from account-bound guild achievements even if you join a different guild.

- [Siege Battle] The grade indicator of Trophy Boxes per grade is now more noticeable.

- [Guild Chat] The UI of the message showing the collected items from the Trophy Box is now more distinguishable.

- [Guild Magic Shop] The icons of premium items are now more highlighted.

- [Repeat Battle] You can now check your device's battery life, time, and Wi-Fi status while under the power-saving mode.

- [Summonhenge] The Engrave Summon list refresh notification will now appear after Summoner Lv. 10.



▶ Game Error Fixes

- Fixed an issue of the Oblivion effect being applied to (Light) Vampire when it revives with (Fire) Valkyrja's [Warrior's Return] after being defeated by (Fire) Ifrit's attacks.

- (Ride) Fixed an issue of the Blue/Red Peddler Penguin being placed in an awkward direction on certain profile screens.​

notes.title: [Info] 2024 January First Update Story
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that Summoners War is turning 10 this year!
We'd like to thank each and every one of you for supporting us for the past 10 years.
We assure you that we'll keep working hard to offer satisfying updates, so please keep supporting us!

To celebrate this special occasion, 10 types of 10th anniversary events are scheduled to go live one by one.
Make sure you stay tuned for them!

For our first update of the year, content QoL updates are underway.
We'll walk you through the details in this Developer's Note!

▶ Addition of the Normal Monster Sealing Feature to the Summoned Monster Sealed Shrine

Summoners War has been around for a long time. This means the number of Monsters has grown as well.
This allowed you to expand your Monster pool, but it came to our attention that the current Monster storage capacity isn't enough to keep up with the constantly growing number of Monsters.

However, simply expanding the Monster storage slots is not an optimal solution.
The current Summoned Monster Sealed Shrine not only stores Monsters, but also saves all the data of equipped Runes/Artifacts on each Monster to allow users to use Monsters in battle. Moreover, the data of all Monsters in the Monster storage are transferred from the server during battles.
Within this system, there are technical difficulties such as high server traffic and high database load to expand the Monster storage.

As for Rune/Artifact slots, we've been expanding the slots and could consider doing this periodically. However, we'd like to maintain the current number of Monster storage slots as they can greatly affect battles in general.

This is where we thought about revamping the Summoned Monster Sealed Shrine to prevent excessive server load and allow you to manage your Monsters with ease.
Summoned Monster Sealed Shrine has been very useful to store Monsters you summoned, but any progressed Monsters could not be stored. We wanted to create another space within the Summoned Monster Sealed Shrine for Summoners who have progressed multiple Monsters.
Therefore, we'll be improving the Summoned Monster Sealed Shrine to allow you to seal Monsters you don't currently need in battles and use them again at appropriate times.

Now, we'll introduce how the Summoned Monster Sealed Shrine will change.

​{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/64d7c471839626f83c40c9b53a5bb1a94a66ab40.png

First, the name will be changed from Summoned Monster Sealed Shrine to Sealed Shrine. You can check the new menus as above by tapping the building.
[① Summoned] will function as the previous Summoned Monster Sealed Shrine and [② Normal] will function as the newly added feature called Normal Monster Sealed Shrine.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/1fa47e8e8bb08e065cc66e61b82dd8c2ca4b2f71.png

The features of the Normal Monster Sealed Shrine are as follows.

===================================================

▶ What's the Normal Monster Sealed Shrine?
- Monsters can be stored regardless of their level, star grade, and skill level.
- Monsters equipped with [Runes/Artifacts] cannot be stored. (Can be stored after unequipping them)
 : Runes/Artifacts equipped for the World Arena will be removed automatically upon storing the Monster.
- [Transmogs/Transmog Items] will be removed from the Monster automatically upon storing the Monster.
- Monsters stored in the [Normal Monster Sealed Shrine] cannot enter battles and be used as power-up/evolution materials.
- (All Attributes) Homunculus (Attack/Support) cannot be stored.

===================================================

As you can see, you'll be able to store Monsters regardless of their progression status. However, you won't be able to store Monsters equipped with Runes/Artifacts, and/or (All Attributes) Homunculus (Attack/Support).
Unlike the Monster Storage that doesn't allow you to store duplicate Monsters in the same slot, the new Normal Monster Sealed Shrine can store up to 300 duplicate Monsters per Monster.

We've organized the details in the table below for your convenience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/a308f6525075cc102052e12b73e16a29b8b502c7.png

The Normal Monster Sealed Shrine will offer 100 slots as default, and you can expand the slots up to 300.
The expansion cost is as follows.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/b86a4126304e27f98d56540ff36b9a3af70458a4.png

By storing Monsters you don't need at the moment in the Normal Monster Sealed Shrine, you'll be able to manage the storage space more efficiently.
This way, we expect that it'll become easier for you to manage the Monsters you're using and decide which Monsters to use for your battles.

The purpose of adding the Normal Monster Sealed Shrine is to alleviate the burden of managing a large number of Monsters.
In addition, we improved the current Monster menus to enhance your convenience even further.

Let's dive into the improved Monster menu UI now!


▶ Monster Menu Improvements

- A Monster Storage Switch feature will be added.

​{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/a7cad8808a70ffdad50e2e36b1925a9045883323.png

Before, you could only manage the Monsters stored in the Monster Storage in certain contexts only through the Rune/Artifact management menu.
With the newly added Monster Storage icon, you'll now be able to manage Monsters and check info such as skill level-ups even when you are in the Monster Storage menu, just like you do in the Monster menu.

By being able to check your Monster list and Monsters stored in the Monster Storage by switching between them, equipping Runes/Artifacts, and awakening them, you'll be able to manage your Monsters very efficiently.
We expect that the Normal Monster Sealed Shrine and Monster menu UI improvements will enhance the overall convenience.

Please be advised the switch button is also available in the World Arena > Monster menu.

- Monster sorting feature will be improved.

​{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/a84afa911f89a02d691fa205f020164a34600b37.png

The condition search feature of the Monster Storage will now be available in the Monster list menu.
With this, you'll be able to search for your Monsters more efficiently.

Lastly, Rune/Artifact management menus will be improved as well.
Let's get to the details!


▶ Rune/Artifact Management Menus Improvements

As you progress in Summoners War, you get to store more Runes/Artifacts than Monsters.
That's why we not only expanded the Rune/Artifact slots but also continued to perform QoL updates including the addition and improvement of the Rune/Artifact management menu as well as the introduction of the auto sell and Sell Exclusion Settings features.
As the drop rate of Runes and Artifacts increased greatly in the Cairos Dungeon and Rift of Worlds content via the v8.1.4 update, Rune/Artifact management has become more crucial.
We believe we need a feature that would allow you to sell and manage Runes you don't use anymore.

That said, we'll be improving the Rune/Artifact management menus once again.
This is not a one-time update. We'll keep improving the feature to enhance the convenience even more.

- The Sell Exclusion Settings of the Repeat Battle will be added to the Rune/Artifact management menus.

​{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/8d0efd48865b4fa1758ec07ffcc648e24258788a.png

The feature will be added to the Rune/Artifact management pages > sell feature >  [① Select All] > [② Sell Exclusion Settings].
When the update goes live, the currently saved Sell Exclusion Settings will be applied, and the items on the Rune/Artifact management pages will be sold based on the same settings you have set in the Repeat Battle.

- A filter option that allows you to only view Ancient grade on the Gem/Grindstone management menus will be added.

​{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/349e45639e2916551040f85685cdc7c146fce434.png

By checking the ""Ancient Only"" filter, you can only view Ancient grade on the Gem/Grindstone management menus. 

-  You can now sell Runes/Artifacts equipped on other Monsters instantly on the Rune/Artifact management menus.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/0b9a83f7d97720ed169e3ddea823546cf52b64ba.png

In order to sell Runes/Artifacts equipped on other Monsters on the management menu, you had to [Remove] the item from the Monster first.
Moving forward, we'll be changing that button to [Sell] so that you can sell the item without having to go through multiple steps.

- A menu that directs you to the management page of another Monster via the equipped Rune/Artifact info on the Rune/Artifact management menus will be added.

​{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752586/dff97eab337288f9a6cc2f7d942ee807de27147b.png

As we'll be allowing you to sell Runes/Artifacts equipped on a different Monster instantly, we'll also be adding a feature that directs you to the Rune management page of that Monster in case you want to remove the Rune or manage the Monster like now.
You can move to the Rune/Artifact management menus of another Monster by tapping the [① Item Thumbnail] displayed by tapping the Rune/Artifact of another Monster and the [② icon].

That's the end of what we have for you in this update!
We anticipate that the improvements we made will help you manage your Monsters, Runes, and Artifacts better.

The update details we shared today are scheduled to be applied to the game in the next update.
(The Developer's Note is intended to help you understand the upcoming update in advance. As development and testing are still underway, we ask you to understand that the actual update may differ from what we shared in this note.)

We'll come back with more exciting update details in the next Developer's Note.

Thanks!
